crossRefs.note: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.
I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will…
But you didn’t learn Christ that way,
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…
They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us.…
As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But…

translations.web: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.
translations.bsb: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
translations.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught
translations.asv: I have not turned aside from thine ordinances; For thou hast taught me.
